description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Earth/Holy damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Wol (Earth, Holy)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Wol (Earth, Holy)
description.text: Increases [Earth/Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Earth or Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Wol (Earth, Holy) after using two Earth or Holy abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Dancing Edge+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [Imperil Earth 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Holy 10% (5s)]

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Holy 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
